source_contract_topics: Part 2A contaminated land and remediation verification
Local Air Quality Management and AQMAs
Strategic noise mapping and action planning
Common land and town or village greens
Community Infrastructure Levy and planning obligations
River basin management and water-body status

source_contract_findings.contaminated_land: Planning controls, Part 2A determination, LCRM risk assessment, options appraisal, remediation implementation and verification were separated. History, desk studies, remediation strategies and voluntary advice were not treated as statutory contamination findings, completed remediation, title, permission or viability.
source_contract_findings.air_quality: LAQM duties, AQMA designation, AQAP measures, annual reporting, monitoring, modelling and the July 2026 PM2.5 target plan were separated. Area status and national trajectories were not treated as parcel concentrations, personal exposure or planning outcomes.
source_contract_findings.noise: Strategic noise maps, annual-average indicators, Noise Important Areas, action plans and permit-noise management were separated. Modelled mapping was not treated as on-site measurement, exact building exposure, planning refusal or completed mitigation.
source_contract_findings.common_land: Common-land and town or village-green registers, section 15 registration, section 16 release or exchange and section 38 works consent were separated. Registers and applications were not treated as freehold title, universal access, planning permission or final works consent.
source_contract_findings.developer_contributions: CIL, section 106, section 278, statutory tests, Infrastructure Funding Statements and contribution open data were separated. Rates, agreements, receipts and allocations were not treated as exact liability, viability or delivered infrastructure.
source_contract_findings.water_quality: Current river basin plans, water-body classifications, objectives, programmes and progress reporting were separated. Status and objectives were not treated as parcel samples, achieved outcomes, permits, licences or development capacity.
